europe_now.title: Ukraine-Russia Conflict Escalation
europe_now.summary: The European Union is transferring 1.4 billion euros in interest from frozen Russian assets to Ukraine. This financial move follows a deadly overnight Russian strike on Kyiv that overwhelmed local air defenses.

europe_now.title: Ceuta Migration Crisis
europe_now.summary: Authorities in Ceuta have issued appeals for aid as the influx of child migrants reaches unsustainable levels. The situation has created an urgent humanitarian crisis in the territory.
